workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Feature Tree

bounded_scope: Sketcher sketch attached to native datum plane
explicit coincident horizontal vertical and origin constraints
width and depth driving dimensional constraints
native PartDesign Pad depending on the sketch
driving width edit from 80 mm to 100 mm
native dependency-tree recompute without manual mesh editing
authoritative single-solid validation before and after edit
OLE datum sketch and feature IDs persist through FCStd reopen
datum-to-sketch and sketch-to-pad dependency links persist through reopen
typed R002 tessellated Blender display derivative
Blender OLE lineage and FCStd/STEP provenance persistence through save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Material changes to the native feature-tree probe, datum/sketch/pad dependency semantics, driving-constraint behavior, Blender feature-tree readback, FreeCAD version or Blender version require a new bounded integration receipt.
authority_note: This validates one native FreeCAD parametric feature-tree path and Blender readback. It does not establish general CAD feature-tree parity or P0-A PASS.
